name: Ingevity
outlook:
What Ingevity says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAFollowing solid third-quarter results, the company is narrowing its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to a range of $385 million to $395 million, maintaining the midpoint of the prior range.
  • Full year 2026: net sales and adjusted EPSThe company expects full-year net sales of approximately $1.1 billion and diluted adjusted EPS of $5.25 to $5.45.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowFree cash flow is now expected to be between $220 million and $230 million, excluding the second quarter $113.2 million litigation settlement payment, reflecting increased capital expenditures and working capital investments as the company enters 2027.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
